player_prompt.intro:
Ko a yi Jokkere {player_id} e wata {colour} ({piece}) e nder wata koɗe Othello.
Ko a guddiri a yi e duɗe e wata ɗin mawɗo a e nder leuru e wata koɗe.
E wata wakati maa, saɗa wata ɗin mawɗo e nder wata koɗe e nder wata hirnaange (kawtal, teddungal, maa diagonal) e nder wata ɗin mawɗo maa e wata ɗin mawɗo e nder wata koɗe. Duniya wata ɗin mawɗo e nder wata koɗe e wata ɗin mawɗo maa.
Nokku e wata wakati e nder fannu '[row, col]'.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} Wala ko haani waɗugo - a footi salla.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} Wala ko haani waɗugo, a footi salla.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jaɓɓorgo Caka haani be laral [row, col].

game_message.must_skip: Jokkere {pid} ({piece}) jaɓa wakati ɗin mawɗo e duɗe e wata wakati.
